variants.title: Variants
variants.description: The routes through this case type, such as Regulier and Met welstand. A case picks one when it is made: the default one, unless a rule picks another. The Phases and tasks tab lists them.

name.title: Name
name.description: What the variant is called, for example Met welstand.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the variant does differently, in one sentence.

isDefault.title: Default
isDefault.description: The route a case takes when no rule picks another one.
